title: Education & work
description: Add the schools you attended after AIS and the places you've worked. Your current school or job (no end year) keeps your "current stage" up to date automatically.

intro.education: Add schools from junior high onwards.

endYear.education: Leave empty if you're still studying there.
endYear.work: Leave empty if you still work there.

hints.visibility: "All members" shows it to every approved member; "Followers only" to people you've accepted and family.

fieldErrors.yearsOrder: The end year must be the same as or after the start year.

orgWillAdd: Not in the list? It will be added as new.

orgHint.school: Start typing to see existing schools.
orgHint.company: Start typing to see existing companies.

twoLevelHint: Pick a category, then optionally the detail.

multipleCurrent.title: {count} entries are marked current
multipleCurrent.body: Your current status uses the newest one, “{name}”. For entries that have ended, add the end year with Edit.
multipleCurrent.bodyAdmin: The current status uses the newest one, “{name}”. Add the end year to entries that have ended.
